rows.note: Use this broad everyday wording for sustained thinking or consideration when the negative worry is not the point.

example.english: I often sit by the window for some rumination and slowly sort out my thoughts.
example.traditional: 我成日坐喺窗邊諗嘢，慢慢整理吓自己嘅想法。
example.jyutping: ngo5 seng4 jat6 co5 hai2 coeng1 bin1 nam2 je5 maan6 maan2 zing2 lei5 haa2 zi6 gei2 ge3 soeng2 faat3

rows.note: Use this written term for especially deep, deliberate reflection rather than ordinary thinking.

example.traditional: 呢個問題值得大家深思。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 man6 tai4 zik6 dak1 daai6 gaa1 sam1 si1

rows.note: Use this for recurring negative thoughts, worrying, or brooding that a person cannot easily stop.

example.english: When I cannot sleep at night, my rumination just will not stop.
example.traditional: 夜晚瞓唔着嗰陣，我嘅胡思亂想總係停唔到。
example.jyutping: je6 maan5 fan3 m4 zoek6 go2 zan6 ngo5 ge3 wu4 si1 lyun6 soeng2 zung2 hai6 ting4 m4 dou2
